column1: # Which tranche of the tag audit each flag belongs to. See tag-audit/README.md.
# Frozen on purpose. Computing tranches from flaginfo.json would shift every flag after
# a new or removed one into another tranche, so some would land in a tranche already
# finished and never be audited, and others would be audited twice. Generated once from
# the 254 codes in flaginfo.json, sorted, tranche n taking every 8th from position n
# (tranche 8 takes positions 8, 16, ...), which is how tranches 1-5 were run.
# A flag added to flaginfo.json later is not listed. The tranche pull request that
# audits it adds it here, under its own number; nothing else adds rows. A row is never
# renumbered once its tranche has been proposed, except to move a flag whose picture
# changed, or that joined, during review to the next tranche: nothing was applied for it.
